plainText:
Kerry Williams is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Williams was born in 1973 and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined in the third season and provided several voices until 4Kids Entertainment gave up their rights of the English dub to Pokémon USA. Years later, she returned to the series starting in Scraggy and the Demanding Gothita!, making her the first former 4Kids voice actor to return to the animated series in .
